name: Old North steeple
notes: Old North Church, Boston (1723, 54 m) at 1:4.5, about 12 m. Faces +Z, origin at base center.
parts: Flemish-bond red brick tower with white wood quoins, string courses and cornice
arched louvered belfry openings and blind arches
two stacked octagonal white-painted wooden stages with pilasters and balustrade
slender tapering spire with copper-green weathervane
lantern window at the upper belfry with two warm emissive panes
style: Georgian New England brick and white painted wood, crisp bevelled trim, weathered brick, patinated copper.
summary: Old North Church steeple, Boston 1:4.5: red brick Georgian tower with white quoins and arched windows, louvered belfry, two octagonal wooden stages, tapering spire and copper weathervane.
